cards.audioText: Your call sign is AFR113, you are holding at holding point A9 of runway 04, you are fully ready. Contact Wuhan Tower and say you're ready for departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是法航113，你现在在跑道04外A9等待点等待，已经完全准备好。联系武汉塔台，告诉他们你准备好离场了。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, AFR113, holding point A9 of runway 04, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，法航113，跑道04外A9等待点，准备好离场了。

cards.audioText: AFR113, hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，在当前位置等待。
cards.referenceText: Holding, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 等待，法航113。

cards.audioText:
AFR113, hold at present position, do you have the traffic on short final in sight?
Tell the controller yes.
cards.audioTextZh:
法航113，在当前位置等待，你看到短五边上的航空器了吗？
告诉管制员已经看到。
cards.referenceText: Affirm, traffic in sight, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 是的，看到航空器了，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, behind the CES 737 on short final, line up behind.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，在短五边上的东航737后，上跑道等待。
cards.referenceText: Behind CES737 on short final, line up behind, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 在短五边上的东航737后，上跑道等待。

cards.audioText: AFR113, cleared for takeoff, when airborne, contact departure 120.2.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，可以起飞，离地后，联系离场120.2。
cards.referenceText: Cleared for takeoff, runway 04,, after airborne, contact departure 120.2, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以起飞，跑道04，离地后，联系离场120.2，法航113。

cards.audioText: You are passing 900m, contact Wuhan Departure, ask if you can cancel the SID, and proceed to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 你现在正在过900米，联系武汉离场。询问是否可以取消SID，直飞LKO.
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Departure, AFR113, passing 900m, request cancel SID and proceed to LKO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉离场，法航113，正在过900米，请求取消SID，直飞LKO。

cards.audioText: AFR113, radar identified, continue climb to 2400m, turn right to LKO.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，雷达识别了，继续上到2400米，右转飞LKO。
cards.referenceText: Continue climb 2400m, turn right to LKO, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续上到2400米，右转飞LKO，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, climb to 4500m and contact Wuhan Control on 119.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，上4500米，联系武汉区调119.7。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 4500m and contact 119.7, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到4500米，联系武汉区调119.7，法航113。

cards.audioText: Your position is just over LKO, the next way-point is DAPRO, ETA at time 34, make the standard position report, and request climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 你刚刚过LKO，下一个位置点是DAPRO，预计到达时间34分，做一个标准位置报，并请求爬升。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, AFR113. maintaining 4500m. Over LKO, next DAPRO at 34, request climb.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，法航113，在4500米保持，过LKO，预计到达下一位置点DAPRO34分，请求爬升。

cards.audioText: AFR113, climb to 5100m, no speed restriction.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，上到5100米，无速度限制。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 5100m, no speed restriction, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 上到5100米，无速度限制，法航113。

cards.audioText: During climb, your port engine failed, tell the controller this situation and you would like to return to land. This is an urgency call.
cards.audioTextZh: 在爬升过程中，你的左发失效了，告诉管制员这一情形，你想返场着陆，这是一个紧急呼叫。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Wuhan Control, AFR113, port engine failure, request return to land.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, 武汉区调，法航113，左发失效，请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: AFR113, Roger PAN, descend to 1800m, turn right heading 360.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，收到PAN，下到1800米，右转航向360。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800m, turn right heading 360, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下到1800米，右转航向360，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, contact Approach 119.85.
Your altitude is 1800m, you have information S, contact approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的高度是1800米，你收到通播S，联系进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan approach, AFR113. 1800m maintaining, information S.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航113，保持在1800米，通播S。

cards.audioText:
AFR113, current information is T, descend to 900m, expect radar vectors for ILS runway 36L.
Read back and ask to use runway 36R to land due to performance limitations.
cards.audioTextZh:
法航113，目前通播是T，下到900米，预计雷达引导ILS进近，跑道36左。
复诵，由于性能限制，请求使用跑道36右着陆。
cards.referenceText: Information T, descend to 900m, Request ILS runway 36R due to performance, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 通播T，下到900米，由于性能，请求跑道36右，法航113。

cards.audioText: AFR113, change landing runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，更换到36右跑道。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道36右，法航113。

cards.audioText: You have just got the information from the cabin that one of your passengers suffered stroke during the incident. Inform the controller and ask for ambulance after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 你从客舱收到一则消息，一名乘客在此事件中中风，告知管制员这个情况，并在着陆后请求救护车。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113, request ambulance after landing due to passenger suffered stroke.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航113，由于乘客中风，在着陆之后请求救护车。

cards.audioText: AFR113, roger, we will notify airport medical assistance, now turn left heading 330, descend to 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 法航113，收到，我们将告知机场医疗救援，现在，左转航向330，下到600米，可以ILS进近，跑道36右。
cards.referenceText: Turn left heading 330, descend to 600m, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, AFR113.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转航向330，下到600米，可以ILS进近，跑道36右，法航113。

cards.audioText: Report that you have intercepted the localizer for RWY 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 报告管制员，你已经截获跑道36右的航向道。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, AFR113., localizer established for runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，法航113，建立了跑道36右的航向道。

cards.audioText: AFR113, contact Tower 124.35.
